accepted_scope: Opt-in reloadable linear parallel hardware target, finite directed Lean/RTL and reference SPI traces, saved generic/typical CMOS5L state-cut equivalence and indexed result ownership. No counted/reactive hardware, paired SRAM, serial package, reset reconnection, physical pads, routing or timing qualification.

proofs.scope: Universal local circuit equations and conditional bounds; directed finite lifecycle tests. No complete initialized compiler/package refinement.

equivalence.scope: All public outputs and surviving logical next-state bits for arbitrary defined inputs and state; only explicitly reported physically absent next-state coordinates are omitted. No initialization or reachability assumption.

synthesis.boundary: Saved generic and typical CMOS5L standard-cell artifacts; no retiming, pads, serial transport, SRAM integration, clock tree, placement, routing, parasitics or timing qualification.

sampler_relation: SPI differential binds the reference samplers to hardware at START; its first leaf does not append RX. Directed Lean/RTL vectors additionally check first-entry RX after pads are primed low. No unconditional constructor-to-START relation.
identity_boundary: Sixteen-bit generation and global transfer counters saturate; warm reset preserves transfer count. Cold initialization requires a fresh software session epoch. Raw token uniqueness across power loss or reconnection is outside this contract.
next_gate: Replace the 4096-bit instruction register bank with SRAM-backed storage and compact counted/reactive lookup while preserving entry timing, ownership and failure prefixes; then version serial commands and prove initialized package composition.
